func processFile(path string, processor func(string) error) error {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
	buf := make([]byte, 0, 64*1024)   // 64KB初始缓冲区
	scanner.Buffer(buf, 10*1024*1024) // 支持10MB长行

	for scanner.Scan() {
		if err := processor(scanner.Text()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return scanner.Err()
}
